req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /tasks/ declares limit with Query(100, ge=1, le=1000). Values above 1000 must yield HTTP 422. We need: (1) a positive case with a valid limit well within range, (2) a negative case with limit clearly above 1000, (3) boundary cases at exactly 1000 (valid), 1001 (invalid), and 999 (valid). Each test imports the FastAPI app in-process and uses TestClient. Assertions are exact to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and off-by-one mutants.

tests.name: test_limit_within_valid_range_returns_200
expected: Response body is a JSON array
Array length is exactly 20 (all rows, since 50 > 20)
trace: R-TASK-007: valid limit (50) is within [1, 1000], so 200 is returned
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_limit_within_valid_range_returns_200():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?limit=50")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_limit_within_valid_range_returns_200()

trace: R-TASK-007: limit=9999 far exceeds le=1000 cap; FastAPI Query validation rejects with 422

from app.main import app
